I am an MSc Quantitative Finance student at University College
Dublin, with a First Class Honours degree in Applied Mathematics
from the University of Galway.

My interests include quantitative research, numerical methods
and machine learning.

## Featured project

### Benchmarking neural networks for option pricing

A comparison of Physics-Informed Neural Networks, Physics-Informed
Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks and the Crank–Nicolson finite-difference
method for Black–Scholes option pricing.

The project examines accuracy, computational cost and performance
across different volatility assumptions.
